author: GamingBolt
description:
With how much work went into E-Day, The Coalition not reusing a single asset from the older games and rebuilding everything from scratch, I don't think it will abandon this new thread and, say, pick up where we left off at the end of Gears 5. 

Then again, it didn't seem like the team would make a prequel after that game's massive cliffhanger, so really, who can say? Whichever way you look at it, it's clear there are plenty more stories to tell on Sera, and more importantly, that they're worth telling. Even if all roads inevitably lead to the same destination – death, decay, destruction, it's the heartfelt stories that ultimately define the journey.
title: Gears of War: E-Day Ending Explained And How It Sets Up The Next Gears Game

author: GamingBolt
description:
Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen has been a pleasure to play right from our first moments in Norgan, and the many grisly deaths we endured at the hands of its many threats. 

That we were rocking powerful builds when it happened is an indicator of how brutal the new region can get, but you’re soon going to find that it’s also abundant in ways to improve your own standing.

That’s the perfect way to make an already potent formula become the best version of itself, and the fact that it doesn’t stop there is among the many reasons it’s going to keep us coming back for more. Join us as we take you through all of them, and tell you more about why Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen is yet another hit game of 2026.
title: Why Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Is So Addictive

author: GamingBolt
description:
If the results indeed speak for themselves in as satirical, larger-than-life, and grotesque a fashion as the development team aims for, then GTA 6 could do more than appeal to the tens of millions of long-time fans or the casual masses. 

It may very well set a new standard for the genre beyond what we expected. Time will tell, as always, but as the weeks count down and it becomes all the more real, Rockstar's vision is becoming all the more blinding in its brilliance.
title: GTA 6 Is Brilliantly Addressing One of the Biggest Issues With Red Dead 2 And GTA 5
